Its nine residents are Tony, Mark, Haize, Ashley, Ralph, Bernie, Mao, Pepper, and Anna. Each brings a particular way of paying attention. Together, they give the village a wider range of questions than any one resident could supply alone. The village is not meant to be a collection of pleasant personalities performing interchangeable activities.
